status: Current MDVu native checks passed on macOS and Windows NAS; competitor comparison incomplete

comparison.scope: macOS individual cold/warm pairs; baseline binaries in full-pass-2026-10-18.json; not a comparison of the later cache correction

cacheCorrection.cause: Replacing an existing SVG at the 128-entry or 16 MiB boundary cleared unrelated warm entries.
cacheCorrection.change: Remove the replaced entry before checking occupancy; reuse one insertion helper for disk reads and renderer writes.

macOSNativeUI.timingMode: actual requestAnimationFrame; warmPasses=3; per-action timings include settling checks

windowsNative.method: Interactive RDP session; actual requestAnimationFrame; two warm scroll passes; not equivalent to local Mac display or input latency. Control actions include settling checks.

ci.scope: Last pushed revision only; current local changes have not been published or checked by GitHub CI

limitations: No proof of maximum possible speed or minimum possible size.
Cold render still has long frame intervals; native macOS fullscreen transition time includes the OS animation.
One observation per app/file/phase; not statistically ranked.
Rust workspace on macOS reports transitive block 0.1.6 future-incompatibility warning.
Windows RDP warm frame p95 on the five documents is 32.7–60.8 ms; a cold onescreen frame reached 250.1 ms. These do not establish universally fast UI.
Post-correction comparative cold/warm startup trials against competitors have not been repeated.
MSI install/uninstall was not repeated for this candidate.
parserScope: Ten parses per fixture in an already-running CLI benchmark; excludes engines, first paint, startup, UI and full traversal.

stressMemory.scope: Forced eager render-all UI audit, not normal lazy reading; includes later harness overhead and all newly attributed WebKit services. Summed memory attribution is approximate.
